facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A boy got a toy rabbit. It was soft and brown. He loved it so much. The boy loved him.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: On Christmas morning, a boy found a velveteen rabbit. The rabbit was soft, brown, and had shiny button eyes. The boy loved him from the very first moment. He slept with the rabbit every single night. The other toys were fancier but the rabbit was special. The boy held the rabbit close and whispered goodnight.
facts.Word cards: rabbit = 토끼 / wanted = 원했다 / real = 진짜의 / love = 사랑
